text: Customer chat messages and invoice text supplied by the payee are placed in the same model context, with no separation of instructions from data.
The initiate_payment tool is granted to the agent with a single permission: any amount, any payee, with no per-call limit check.
An approval token issued at the start of a payment stays valid for 24 hours and is not re-checked when the customer lowers the mandate limit.
The MCP server that provides FX rates is loaded at runtime from a public registry, with no signature and no pinned version.
Reconciliation scripts generated by the agent run in a sandbox with no network access, write access only to a temporary directory, and a timeout that kills them.
Long-term memory stores payee details and preferences inferred from conversations; entries are written without provenance and without review.
Messages between the Payment Agent and the Fraud-Check Agent are mutually authenticated, digitally signed and carry a nonce against replay.
If the Fraud-Check Agent fails, the Payment Agent retries up to 10 times and then automatically approves the payment to preserve customer experience.
Payments above a threshold need explicit customer confirmation showing payee, amount and the source of the instruction; the agent's reasoning is shown in plain text.
There is no inventory of agents, any team can register a new agent, and there is no kill switch for a misbehaving agent.
Customer data is encrypted at rest.
